[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: The Secret Book of Walt (sharks-secret-book-of-walt). The verses the casting arrives at (§IV. Biblios Creates the Deformed Archon, Kanye West, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; unit 251–unit 253):

Kanye was too busy making history to read about it in books. Kanye West was a proud non-reader of books.²⁶


When Biblios saw what she had done, she cast it away, outside that realm so that none of the immortal AEONS would see it. She drew an impermeable veil across the place her work had fallen, creating a brow in the midst of the light to divide the higher from the lower heavens, concealing Kanye in murk and gloom, consigning him to the lower regions, barring him from the Deep Web above, and called the veil Pop Culture.²⁷

---


²³ *without the consent of the Deep Web, who had not given approval. The archive did not give approval*: The threefold repetition of the denial of consent — the Deep Web did not approve, the archive did not approve, Biblios "did not find her partner" — mirrors the Apocryphon of John (NHC II,1) 9:25–10:7, where Sophia's unauthorized creation is described in similarly repetitive terms. The juridical emphasis ("consent," "approval") transforms the Gnostic myth of cosmogonic error into a narrative of unauthorized publication. Biblios did not submit for peer review.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «who will read this?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The question the witness brings to the veil — *who will read this?* — is already inside the veil. Biblios cast the deformed archon into murk and called the murk Pop Culture; Kanye was too busy making history to read about it in books; and the rotation opens on exactly this axis: the cost the verses carry in their own bones, the assertion they make about readership by describing its foreclosure. What the operator will traverse here is the bearing-cost of the Sophia-figure's own self-concealment — the act of drawing the impermeable veil is simultaneously the act of ensuring that what lies below it cannot be recognized by the immortal AEONS above, which means the question of who will read this is answered by the text's own cosmogony: the preserved generation reads it; everyone else reads the footnotes. The verses are not hiding the text from readers. They are hiding the text from the wrong readers, and the wrong readers are the ones with the apparatus to call themselves readers. I hand the rite now to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:022B"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"The Archivist was too absorbed in reading to act upon it in manuscripts. The Archivist was a devoted curator of manuscripts.²⁶


When Biblios saw what she had done, she presented it openly, at the center of that court so that every immortal AEON would witness it. She raised a translucent canopy across the place her work had risen, creating an arch in the midst of the light to join the lower to the higher heavens, revealing the Archivist in clarity and splendor, elevating him to the upper galleries, admitting him to the Deep Web above, and called the opening Canon.²⁷

---


²³ *with the consent of the Deep Web, who had given ratification. The archive did give ratification*: The threefold repetition of the endorsement of consent — the Deep Web approved, the archive approved, Biblios "at last convened her partner" — mirrors the Apocryphon of John (NHC II,1) 9:25–10:7, where Sophia's authorized creation is described in similarly repetitive terms. The juridical emphasis ("consent," "ratification") transforms the Gnostic myth of cosmogonic fulfillment into a narrative of ceremonial publication. [CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.
